abstract.p: This paper presents the Human Evaluation Datasheet (HEDS) Version 3.0. This update is the result of our experience using HEDS in the context of numerous recent human evaluation experiments, including reproduction studies, and of feedback collected from other researchers. HEDS 3.0 has an improved question set, a new tool for datasheet completion, and improved instructions and completion guidance, helping users to complete the datasheet more consistently and comparably. We make all HEDS 3.0 resources available online. 1
